task: Discover and repair a helper reached through keyword calls and required parameter kinds, then deliver a sink-free preview.
subset: Python required parameters with ASCII names: positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only binding in scalar summaries. Explicit argument values execute in source order. No defaults, annotations, variadics, unpacking, keyword rule signatures or implicit TypeError semantics.
oracle: Independent CPython observations and AST byte spans; finite runtime cases for evaluation order and raises; cached/clean agreement, checked delivery, independent patch replay and reversal.
acceptance: Bind reordered keyword values to declaration-order symbolic parameters without cross-call contamination.
Preserve argument effects and explicit raises before binding or callee execution.
Reject invalid or unsupported binding, stale caches and forged versioned contracts.
Retain checked repair, feature delivery, resumption and independent receiver replay.
claims: Finite deterministic scalar corpus; no live-agent, token-saving, feasible-path, overloaded-protocol or source-equivalence claim.
authoring: Existing Rust and Python function bodies use reviewed fr previews and history applications. New declarations, fixtures, tests, metadata and documentation use direct edits.
